item.text: The scan currently reads a global flag even though the repository also has a per-server WordPress setting. I also found that the cache stores strings, so it cannot represent a present key with a nil value. I’m changing the cache values to string pointers and updating the scan to use the server setting, while keeping the existing command-line flag effective.

item.text:
Updated the WordPress cache lookup to use the map directly and treat a nil value as a cache miss. Package filtering now honors the per-server `IgnoreInactive` setting while preserving the existing report flag, excluding inactive plugins and themes while keeping active ones.

Added regression coverage. `GOPROXY=off go test ./wordpress ./report` and `git diff --check` pass.
